lifecycle.retention: Retain source versions and projections until whole-migration acceptance and lifecycle review.

value.command: Run focused DiagnosticsGpsFixWitnessTest, DiagnosticsGpsPlatformTest, AppDiagnosticsTest and GpsDisplayRetentionTest locally with existing GPS recovery/controller and HTTP/sync real-error preservation tests.
value.expected: Fifteen pure witness cases and API30/36 Robolectric adapters cover fixed ten-key numeric/enum output, missing/invalid/future/denied/read/clock states, older/same/newer arithmetic, scalar-only extraction, unchanged Location payload and legacy replay. Independent source/native fixture assertions distinguish measurement time from receipt age. A successful JVM run does not reproduce real vendor GNSS delivery loss; native emulator cases and physical follow-up are separate, never silently executed under a paused scope.
